summary: Iteration 2 — Regression + 2 bug fixes + multi-viewport responsive sweep on the redesigned MedLingo Vite site at http://localhost:3000. All 8 review items PASS with 0 console errors, 0 page errors. Both targeted bug fixes (footer logo stretch, back-to-top position) are correctly resolved across all tested viewports.

issues: Cosmetic only: status text renders as '0 / 200 claimed· 200 left' — the middle dot has no leading space producing 'claimed·' joined. Not blocking; wraps within card as required. Main agent may add a space before · for typographic polish.

test_results.BUG_FIX_1_footer_logo_aspect: PASS — at 1440/1280/1024/768/414/390/360 the .footer__logo bbox is exactly 38x38 (aspect 1.0, diff=0). Computed alignSelf='flex-start', objectFit='contain'. No horizontal stretch.
test_results.BUG_FIX_2_back_to_top_position: PASS — after scroll past 500px on 1440 and 390: computed position='fixed', x is near right edge (right_gap=28px @1440, 18px @390 — NOT at x=0). Click smooth-scrolls to scrollY=0 (verified on 390px).
test_results.RESPONSIVE_mobile_menu_390: PASS — navbar-menu-button opens mobile-menu showing exactly ['Features','Modules','Team','Get Early Access']. theme-toggle-mobile flips data-theme (dark->light). Clicking Modules link closes menu and scrolls to #modules (scrollY=4453).
test_results.RESPONSIVE_waitlist_perk_390_360: PASS — at 390px: card w=292, bar w=250 (no overflow, right gap 21px); status renders on 2 lines (h=43px, lh=21.5). At 360px: card w=262, bar w=220 (no overflow); status 2 lines. Bar stays inside card.
test_results.RESPONSIVE_hero_360: PASS — title 'Learn Medical English Like a Clinical Professional' wraps cleanly; flashcard renders above title (flashcard_top=192 < title_top=627); both CTAs visible with height=54px (tap-friendly); flashcard tap toggles aria-pressed false->true.
test_results.RESPONSIVE_grid_collapse: PASS — @360: Activities=1col, Modules=1col, Team=1col. @768: Activities=2cols, Modules=3cols, Team=1col. Matches spec.
test_results.REGRESSION_navbar_glass_on_scroll: PASS — navbar className becomes 'navbar scrolled' after scrolling past 30px.
test_results.REGRESSION_theme_toggle_and_persistence: PASS — desktop toggle flips light->dark, localStorage['medlingo-theme']='dark'; after reload data-theme='dark' persists.
test_results.REGRESSION_smooth_scroll_navlinks: PASS — clicking navlink-modules smooth-scrolls #modules into view (top within 200px of 0).
test_results.REGRESSION_hero_flashcard_flip: PASS — aria-pressed toggles false->true on click @1440 and @360.
test_results.REGRESSION_modules_phase_tabs: PASS — modules-tab-phase1/phase2 switch works; phase2 reveals 29 lock-class nodes (lock overlay).
test_results.REGRESSION_waitlist_counter_124: PASS — animated counter reaches exactly '124' when waitlist scrolls into view (verified after 2.8s wait).
test_results.REGRESSION_waitlist_formspree_submit: PASS — form submits and [data-testid='waitlist-success'] becomes visible (Formspree mocked for determinism).
test_results.REGRESSION_navbar_logo_size: PASS — navbar__logo: 44x44 @390px, 38x38 @360px (380px breakpoint active). object-fit=contain, max-width=160px.
test_results.REGRESSION_console_errors: PASS — 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors across all viewport runs.

critical_code_review_comments: Both bug fixes are surgical and correct: .app > *:not(.back-to-top) selector restores fixed positioning; .footer__logo align-self:flex-start + object-fit:contain solves the stretch in a column flex parent.

Cosmetic nit: in /app/src/components/Waitlist.jsx the new perk status string '0 / 200 claimed· 200 left' is missing a space before the middle-dot separator. Consider 'claimed · 200 left' or 'claimed • 200 left' for typographic consistency. Not blocking.

Modules grid at 768px renders 3 columns (228px each). Spec language was 'single column at the smallest' which is satisfied at 360px (1 col). The 3-col at 768 is a deliberate design choice — flag only if main agent wants a tablet 2-col breakpoint.

Counter animation works as designed but relies on IntersectionObserver firing exactly once; if user scrolls past quickly during slow network, the 124 final value may not animate. Pre-existing behavior, not a regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vite dev server at http://localhost:3000 (no /app/frontend; project root is /app). No backend. Mock https://formspree.io/** for deterministic waitlist tests. Theme key: localStorage['medlingo-theme']. Mobile breakpoint = 860px; extra-small breakpoint = 380px (navbar logo shrinks). When clicking [data-testid='back-to-top'] use force=True because of the gentle bounce animation (Playwright considers it 'not stable'). Footer logo expected dimensions: 38x38 square at every viewport.
rca of the issue: No new issues. Bug-fix RCA confirmed: (1) Back-to-top was previously trapped under '.app > *' rule that forces position:relative — the new ':not(.back-to-top)' carve-out lets the button keep position:fixed. (2) Footer logo was a flex item in a column flex parent (footer__brand) where the implicit cross-axis stretch was making the square 1024x1024 PNG render full-width; align-self:flex-start + object-fit:contain + flex-shrink:0 fixes it. Both fixes verified across 7 viewports.
